# Pixel Memory Match

A simple, offline browser-based memory match game built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## How to Play

- Open `index.html` in any modern browser.
- Click or tap a card to flip it. Match two cards with the same color to keep them open.
- The move counter increments each time you flip two cards.
- Match all 8 pairs to win. A win message will appear with your total moves.
- Click the **New Game** button to restart with a fresh shuffle.

## Features

- 8 pairs of colored cards (16 cards total)
- Move counter
- Win detection with message
- New Game button
- Keyboard accessible (Tab to navigate, Enter/Space to activate)
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- No external dependencies or network requests

## Files

- `index.html` – main structure
- `style.css` – styling and layout
- `script.js` – game logic

## Run Locally

No server required. Simply open `index.html` in your browser.
